title: Centripetal Acceleration on a Circular Orbit
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: A satellite orbits on circle r = 4 with constant angular velocity d(theta)/dt = 5 rad/s. Find its acceleration vector in polar coordinates.

steps.title: Determine Radial and Angular Derivatives
steps.explanation: Since radius and angular velocity are constant, all higher time derivatives vanish.

steps.title: Apply Polar Acceleration Formula
steps.why: Demonstrating purely centripetal nature of acceleration.
